posts.instagram:
Everyone is talking about AI agents. Your job is figuring out how they would actually fit into the systems you run.

A Quick Guide to Agentic AI for IT Professionals is a short guide for IT professionals who want a clear look at agent-based systems. It covers agentic AI architectures, governance, AI operations and enterprise automation.

It looks at how agent-based systems fit into modern technology environments, so you can think it through before your team builds anything.

💻 A Quick Guide to Agentic AI for IT Professionals: Architectures, Governance, AI Operations, and Enterprise Automation, from TechVerse Technology Books

Sixth grade math moves fast, and ratios, fractions and algebra can start to feel shaky.

Exam Prep Math Activity Book Grade 6 is a math practice book for sixth graders getting ready for tests. It covers addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, algebra, ratios and fractions.

Use it alongside classroom learning or for independent review at home, a little at a time.
